استطرتن (form X)
# اِسْتَطَرْتُنَّ (istaṭartunna) /is.ta.tˤar.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَطَارَ (istaṭāra)
# اُسْتُطِرْتُنَّ (ustuṭirtunna) /us.tu.tˤir.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَطَارَ (istaṭāra)
